note: Planning report only. Families are review notes; admission still needs a reviewed CardRevisionSnapshot.

families.summary: Conditions and filters on Gig values: min/max, value-pairs, even/odd, 8+, die type, counts compared with a Rival.
families.notes: Conditions only, each a fixed shape.

families.summary: Draw cards, fixed or conditional.
families.notes: Routed. Variable counts need SCALED_AMOUNT; 'may draw' needs an optional prompt.

families.summary: Generic target filters and board conditions: classification, cost, power, ready/spent, equipped, face-up, named, lowest power.
families.notes: Documented as unsupported: generic condition/filter language. Each admitted filter is a literal.

families.summary: Activated abilities with a [Spend] cost (and optional Eddie cost) on Legends, Units or Gear.
families.notes: Admitted only for Kerry: The Last Rockerboy (a Unit). Face-up Legend [Spend] abilities and Gear [Spend] abilities are not.

families.summary: Equip a Gear to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend; Gear power adds to its host.
families.notes: Equip onto Units is supported for the admitted Gear. Gear on a Legend host in combat (a Go Solo Legend) is unsupported.

families.summary: Power or keyword changes 'this turn' on a chosen Unit.
families.notes: Fixed amounts on RIVAL_UNIT, SOURCE_SUBJECT or FRIENDLY_UNIT. Keyword grants, all-Unit and filtered targets are missing.

families.summary: Top-of-deck manipulation: search/look/reveal top N, trash from the top (Trash N), bottom-deck the rest.
families.notes: SEARCH_GEAR (count<=5, Gear with max cost, take<=2) only.

families.summary: Who may attack what and when: can't attack, may attack ready/spent Units, must attack, can't be blocked.
families.notes: Restrictions on the card itself are supported; permissions granted by effects, forced attacks and off-turn timing are not.

families.summary: Discard: self discard, a Rival discards, discard as a cost, discard a hand.
families.notes: DISCARD_CARDS supports only the controller discarding exactly 1.

families.summary: Amounts computed from the board: 'for each', 'equal to'.
families.notes: Only Royce's per-equipped-Gear modifier counts anything.

families.summary: [Play] abilities and Program bodies resolving when played.
families.notes: Trigger WHEN_PLAYED.

families.summary: [Quick] timing: Programs and activated abilities usable in the react window.
families.notes: Quick Programs are supported for Floor It, Reboot Optics and Detonate. Quick activated [Spend] abilities on Legends, Units and Gear are not offered in any react window yet.

families.summary: Play a card by an effect: from hand, trash or deck top, for free or for its cost, with after-play riders.
Lasting and delayed effects: 'until your next turn', 'next time ... this turn', 'at the end of this turn'.
'Choose one effect' (and 'choose both instead' upgrades).
families.notes: PendingChoice MODE exists for setup, search and Gig steps, but no ability carries modes.

families.summary: 'First time each turn', 'this turn you played', 'if it stole or fought this turn'.
families.notes: Guards FIRST_BLUE_UNIT_OR_GEAR_PLAY_PER_TURN and FIRST_FRIENDLY_ARASAKA_UNIT_ATTACK_PER_TURN.

families.summary: Move a Unit off the field other than defeat: bottom-deck it or return it to hand.
families.notes: MOVE_CARD is schema-only with no handler.

families.summary: Ready Eddies, sell cards from unusual zones, pay Eddies during resolution.
families.notes: READY_EDDIES (controller, 1 or 2) only.

families.summary: Increase, decrease, adjust or set Gig values.
families.notes: Maxima are fixed literals; 'set to the value of another Gig' and 'adjust by exactly 1' are missing. MODIFY_GIG_VALUE is schema-only.

families.summary: [Go Solo]: play a Legend as a ready Unit that can attack this turn and is removed when it leaves the field.
families.notes: Supported only for Go Solo Legends with no other text or with Blocker (V: Corporate Exile, Goro: Hands Unclean). Go Solo Legends with Play/Attack/Defeated triggers, Go Solo cost changes and Gear on Legend hosts in combat are not.

families.summary: [Call] abilities of a Legend.
families.notes: Trigger WHEN_CALLED; only Viktor's search is routed. Every other Call body needs its effects routed too.

families.summary: WHEN_SPENT: 'when this Unit or Legend is spent' (includes Zetatech Faceplate).
families.notes: Documented as unsupported; needs every spending path (attack, Blocker, [Spend] costs, effects) to emit one event.

families.summary: Defeat a Unit or Gear chosen with a filter.
families.notes: Filters are fixed literals (power at most 5, power at most a friendly d20, Gear power at most 2).

families.summary: Play-cost reductions, alternative costs, ability-cost and Go Solo cost changes.
Call a Legend by an effect or for free outside the normal Call.
Printed [Blocker] on a Unit, or granted to a Gear's host.
families.notes: Keyword BLOCKER. Temporary grants by an effect are TEMPORARY_BUFF.

families.summary: Gig control outside the ordinary attack steal: swap, extra steal, steal fewer, steal prevention.
families.notes: Documented as unsupported (control transfer / steal).

families.summary: Fight-scoped rules: power while fighting, can't be defeated in a fight, wins all fights against, fight-outcome riders.
families.notes: Only Reboot Optics' next-fight prevention.

families.summary: Spend or ready Units and Legends by an effect, and 'can't ready' locks.
families.notes: SPEND_UNIT (rival, cost at most 4) only; readying Units or Legends is missing.

families.summary: Return a card from the trash (or from cards just trashed) to hand.
[Attack] abilities and 'when a Unit attacks' triggers.
families.notes: Triggers WHEN_ATTACKING and WHEN_UNIT_ATTACKS.

families.summary: Triggers on winning or losing a fight, or winning by a margin.
families.notes: Trigger WHEN_FIGHT_WON (Satori). Losing a fight and win margins are missing.

families.summary: Triggers when a Unit or Legend steals a Gig.
families.notes: Only the history condition SUBJECT_STOLE_GIG_THIS_TURN exists (Delamain Cab); there is no steal trigger.

families.summary: Conditions on Street Cred.
families.notes: Nearly complete as conditions; gating an effect mode on them is not.

families.summary: Move Gear between hosts, or defeat a friendly Gear as a cost or choice.
'If X would ..., instead ...' replacement effects.
[Defeated] abilities.
families.notes: Trigger WHEN_DEFEATED, admitted only for Dexter: One Last Chance.

families.summary: 'At the end of your turn' abilities.
families.notes: Trigger WHEN_OWN_TURN_ENDS; only Eddie readying is routed.

families.summary: Other event triggers: another friendly Unit defeated, a Rival adjusting or swapping friendly Gigs.
Look at friendly face-down Legends.
families.notes: One Legend, attack-triggered (Kiroshi Optics). 'All face-down Legends' is missing.

families.summary: Effects on all Units or each player.
A Rival makes a choice for the controller's effect.
Continuous modifiers: auras, while-attacking power, conditional keywords.
families.notes: Each admitted modifier is a bespoke shape.

families.summary: Hooks on rolling a Gig die: rerolls and triggers on rolled results.
[Adrenaline]: the Unit can attack the turn it is played.
families.notes: Keyword ADRENALINE (Riding Nomad). Conditional or granted Adrenaline also needs STATIC_MODIFIER or TEMPORARY_BUFF.

families.summary: Source record with no rules text, cost or RAM: not a playable card in this snapshot.
families.notes: Rebecca: Having a Moment is reviewed with execution UNSUPPORTED as a negative fixture.

families.summary: 'When this Unit uses [Blocker]' triggers.
families.notes: Blocker redirection exists but emits no trigger.

families.summary: 'When you play a <filter> card' triggers.
families.notes: Trigger WHEN_CARD_PLAYED with guard FIRST_BLUE_UNIT_OR_GEAR_PLAY_PER_TURN (Jackie: Pour One Out).

families.summary: 'At the start of your turn' abilities.
families.notes: No start-of-turn trigger exists.

families.summary: No rules text beyond reminder or flavour text: ordinary play, attack and fight.
families.notes: Psycho Squad, Animals Wrecker, Rockn Rockerboy and Emergency Atlus are admitted with no abilities.

rulesQuestions.question: These Gear print no equip reminder text. Are they equipped like every other Gear (Kiroshi erratum says all Gear share the reminder), and what does [Spend] on Overwatch spend: the Gear's host?
The Relic is a Gear whose [Defeated] says 'bottom-deck this Unit'. Is 'this Unit' the Gear itself, its host, or the played Unit; and does [Defeated] fire when the Gear or its host is defeated?
Do [Play], [Attack] and [Defeated] on a Legend fire when it is played or acts through [Go Solo], and does [Defeated] fire when a Go Solo Legend is removed from the game instead of trashed?
'Can attack spent rival Units the turn it's played': does it apply to a Unit already played this turn, only to one played later this turn, or both?
When does a Legend steal a Gig: only as a Go Solo Unit, or also some other way? Westbrook restricts 'rival Legends' stealing.

How do steal modifiers stack in one attack: an extra steal (Gorilla Arms, Appetite), 'steals 1 fewer' (Take Control) and a prevented steal (Alt: Mother of Daemons), including the 10-power extra steal?
Two replacement effects for the same defeat (Mama's Favorite and Deadman Transmitter): who chooses the order, and does defeating Jackie 'instead' remove it from the game or trash it?

Which spending counts as 'is spent' (attacking, using [Blocker], paying a [Spend] cost, being spent by a rival effect such as Corporate Surveillance), and does a card that enters the field spent trigger it?
Does the reroll replace the first result before 'min or max value' draws are checked, and does a Gig rolled as a d20 at its max also count as a max for the d20 draw-3 clause only once?
Muamar's '[Spend] Adjust a Gig by 1' (no 'up to'): must it change the value, and in which direction may it go at a die's min or max?
'Each player discards their hand and may draw 5': who decides each player's draw, and in which order do players act?
Misty chooses among card types 'Unit, Gear and Program'. Is Legend a choosable type (a Legend can't be in the deck), and is the list exhaustive?
